# Design Handoff Checklist

Use this checklist to ensure a smooth handoff from design to engineering.

- [ ] Finalized designs at required fidelity (screens, flows, components)
- [ ] Interaction specs and edge cases documented
- [ ] Accessibility requirements and color/contrast checks completed
- [ ] Assets and design tokens exported and shared
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and success metrics documented
- [ ] API contracts or data requirements identified
- [ ] Performance or animation notes included
- [ ] Design owner available for questions during implementation
- [ ] Post-implementation UX review scheduled

Guidance:
- Keep the checklist linked from the PR and mark completed items in the PR description.
